desc.en: He was born in 1 AH. He hosted Muslim ibn Aqil in Kufa but was imprisoned in the dungeons of Ubaydullah ibn Ziyaad during the massacre at Karbala. After his release he launched a campaign under the leadership of Ibrahim ibn Malik’e Ashtar to avenge the martyrdom of Imam Husain (a.s). During his uprising many involved in the martyrdom of Imam Husain (a.s) and his family, were pursued and killed including Shimr ibn Zil Jawshan, Khowli ibn Yazid, Umar ibn Saad and Ubaydullah ibn Ziyaad. After 18 months of rule in Kufa, Mukhtar was killed by Musab ibn Zubair in 67 AH. Recite his ziyarat in the following way…
desc.rurdu: Janabe Mukhtar 1 hijri mein paiyda huwe. Unho ne Janabe Muslim ki madad ki magar Waqeya Karbala ke waqt woh Ubaydullah ibne Ziyaad ke qaid khaane mein thay. Jab qaid se rehaah huwe to unho ne Ibrahim Ibne Malik’e Ashtar ke saath Imam Husain (a) aur unke ghar waalo’n ke qaatilo’n se intekaam liya jis mein Shimr ibne Zil Jawshan, Khowli ibne Yazid, Umar ibne Saad aur Ubaydullah ibne Ziyaad bhi shaamil hai. Takreeban 18 mahine Kufa mein hukumat ki aur 67 hijri mein Musab ibne Zubair ke haatho shaheed huwe. Unki ziyarat is tarah se padhe…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْوَلِیُ النَّاصِحُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اَبَا اِسْحَاقَ الْمُخْتَارِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْآخِذُ بِالثَّارِ الْمُحَارِبُ لِلْكَفَرَۃِ الْفُجَّارِ۔

lines.rarabic: AS SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL A’BDUS SAALE-HO. AS SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL WALE-YOON NAASE-HO. SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA ABAA IS-HAA-QAL MUKHTAARE. SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL AAKHE-ZO BIS-SAARIL MO-HAARE-BO LIL-KAFARA-TIL FUJ-JAARE.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant! Peace be upon you, O sincere friend! Peace be upon you, O Aba Ishaq al-Mukhtar! Peace be upon you, O avenger, warrior battling against evil disbelievers!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُخْلِصُ لِلهِ فِیْ طَاعَتِهٖ وَلِزِّیْنِ الْعَابِدِیْنَ فِیْ مَحَبَّتِهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَنْ رَضِیَ عَنْهُ النَّبِیُّ الْمُخْتَارُ وَقَسِیْمُ الْجَنَّۃِ وَالنَّرِ وَكَاشِفُ الْكَرْبِ وَالْغُمَّۃِ قَائِمًا لَمْ یَصِلْ اِلَیْهِ اَحَدُ مِنَ الْاُمَّۃِ۔

lines.rarabic: AS SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYO-HAL MUKHLE-SO LIL-LAAHE FEE TAA-A’TE-HI WA LIZZEE-NIL AA’BE-DEENA FEE MA-HABBATE-HE. AS SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA MAN RAZEYA A’N-HUN NABIYYUL MUKHTAA-RO WA QASEE-MUL JANNATE WAN-NARE WA KAA-SHE-FUL KARABE WAL GHUMMA-TE QAA-E-MAN LAM YA-SIL ILAI-HE AHADO MINAL UMMATE.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O the one sincere in his obedience to Allah and in his love for Imam Zayn ul Abedin (a.s). Peace be upon you, O the one with whom were pleased the chosen Prophet, the distributor of heaven and hell and the remover of grief and sorrow. None from the community reach such a position.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَنْ بَذَلَ نَفْسَهٗ فِیْ رَضَائِ الْاَئِمَّۃِ فِیْ نُصْرَۃِ الْعِتْرَۃِ الطَّاهِرِیْنَ۔ وَالْآخِذُ بِثَارِهِمْ مِنَ الْعِصَابَۃِ الْمَلْعُوْنَۃِ الْفَاجِرَۃِ۔ فَجَزَاكَ اللهُ عَنِ النَّبِیِّ وَعَنْ اَهْلِ بَیْتِهٖ عَلَیْهِمُ السَّلَامُ۔

lines.rarabic: AS SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA MAN BAZALA NAFSA-HU FEE REZAA-IL AIMMATE FEE NUSRA-TIL I’TRA-TIT TAAHE-REENA WAL AAKHE-ZO BE-SAARE-HIM MINAL E’SAA-BATIL MAL-OO’NA-TIL FAAJE-RATE. FA-JAZAA-KAL LAAHO A’NEEN NABIYYE WA A’N AHLE BAIYTE-HI A’LAIHE-MUS SALAAMO.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O the one who sacrificed himself to please the Imams by aiding the pure progeny, who avenged them from the cursed evil group. So, may Allah reward you on behalf of the Prophet and his household, peace be upon them.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
